title: zkID seed
description: One extracted, evidence-backed over-disclosure problem paired with the minimal-disclosure mechanism that addresses (or fails to address) it. The unit of input diversity for idea agents.

problem.description: The over-disclosure problem in the source's own domain vocabulary.

abstract_problem.description: Same problem restated domain-neutrally (who must prove what small fact, and what extra they end up seeing). This is what gets embedded and paraphrased for retrieval.

mechanism.description: The minimal-disclosure mechanism, or 'none' / 'legally blocked' when the source shows a failure or a barrier.

domain.description: Field of the source, from config/domains.yaml.

distance_class.description: Relative to the zkID/identity-credential domain, fixed at extraction time. Per-cell distance is computed later.

corpus_source.description: id from sources/*.yaml this seed was mined from, if any.

quote.description: Verbatim span from the fetched source.

quote_verified.description: True only if scripts/verify_quotes.py found the quote in the stored copy of the source.

snapshot.description: Path or hash of the stored fetched copy.

axes.description: Coverage tags used for stratified sampling, not for retrieval.
